title: Мої приватні добірки
roles: R05 після входу; тимчасова добірка можлива без акаунта
fields_and_relations: Власні списки, owner і expires_at; тимчасовий guest draft поза БД.
required_interaction: Створити/перейменувати; після входу persist з NN owner; чужа добірка недоступна.

implementation.view_model: Private collection list, search, creation, rename and confirmed soft removal
limitations: Public profile supports explicit synthetic non-consent access bases; O45 consent evaluation, curator rights/publication workbench and delivery/index services are pending.
Shared browser fixture is a prototype, not a secure server-side public API; real private data must not be loaded into it.
Guest drafts are not persisted; login is required for saved collections.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store v5; incremental migration from v1–4 preserves user work
permissions: Public projection: published + exact current effective access basis + explicit fields/use/resource rules
Collections: active account, owner, lifetime and retired state; professional roles never confer ownership
implementation.atomicity: Revision conflict check; mutate clone; validate references/snapshots/file hashes; commit once. Public withdrawal immediately rechecks display/download/citation.
